verdicts.rationale: services/orders/db.py sets statement_timeout to '0' on the read session (@@ -14,2 +14,4), disabling cancellation entirely rather than raising the cap. Slow SELECTs now run until the 30s gateway timeout while holding their connections, which is precisely the 504s and long-running queries in the alert. Six changed lines, shipped in the deploy 30 minutes before the alert.

The 800-line repository split moves query functions verbatim into services/orders/queries.py with no change to SQL or session setup, and it is not in the deploy that precedes the alert. Large diff, low risk.
